summary: Authored tasks-lens-b.md partitioning the skill-anchoring-guardrails change into a single consolidated dispatch unit and wave plan. Checked prefix disjointness collisions on cmd/lucind-ai/cli.go and compile-time signature dependencies across internal packages, recommending a single packet without an apply-dag.yaml sidecar.

hard_stops.hard_stop: No partition exists in which every wave is green on its own. Say so; a single packet is a legitimate answer.
Two units that must run in the same wave cannot have disjoint allowed_paths because they edit the same file.
The design's file-changes table does not determine which unit owns a file.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.
